# Hands for Living

> > Certified Hand Therapists providing specialized upper extremity therapy, custom orthotics, and ergonomics services in Lynnwood and Redmond, Washington since 2011.

Hands for Living is a hand therapy clinic offering comprehensive services including treatment for carpal tunnel syndrome, hypermobility disorders like Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, therapeutic exercise, custom orthoses, ergonomic assessments, and telehealth consultations. The clinic operates multiple locations and is staffed by certified hand therapy professionals.

## Key Topics

- Hand Therapy
- Certified Hand Therapists

## Core Services

- [Hand Therapy](https://handsforliving.com/hand-therapy): Overview of hand therapy services including carpal tunnel and injury treatment
- [Therapeutic Exercise](https://handsforliving.com/therapeutic-exercise): Therapeutic exercise services for pain relief and function restoration
- [Custom Orthotics](https://handsforliving.com/custom-orthoses): Custom orthoses and orthotics for upper extremity pain relief and treatment
- [Hypermobility & EDS Treatment](https://handsforliving.com/hypermobility): Hypermobility and Ehlers Danlos Syndrome treatment services in Lynnwood
- [Ergonomics Evaluation](https://handsforliving.com/ergonomics): Ergonomics evaluation and workplace injury prevention services in Lynnwood
- [Telehealth Consultations](https://handsforliving.com/video-conference): Telehealth video consultation services with Certified Hand Therapists
